name: MSCI
description: MSCI sells indexes, portfolio analytics, sustainability and climate data, and private-assets data to asset managers, banks and owners. Its biggest earner is Index (57 percent of revenue, 72 percent of adjusted EBITDA): clients pay subscriptions for index data and, more lucratively, fees based on the assets in funds and ETFs that track MSCI indexes (asset-based fees were 43 percent of Index revenue). That asset-linked piece makes revenue partly dependent on equity markets and fund flows. Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin was 60.8 percent and recurring subscriptions 73 percent of revenue.

businessLines.name: Index
businessLines.how: Subscriptions for index data and licences (957.9) plus fees on assets in ETFs and funds tracking MSCI indexes (770.7, charged on fund assets under management or trading volumes per the 10-K) and non-recurring fees (58.2).

businessLines.name: Analytics
businessLines.how: Annual subscriptions to multi-asset portfolio risk and performance analytics tools for asset managers and owners; almost all recurring.

businessLines.name: Sustainability and Climate
businessLines.how: Subscriptions to ESG ratings, climate risk and sustainability data and analytics.

businessLines.name: All Other - Private Assets
businessLines.how: Subscriptions for private real-estate and private-capital data, indexes and analytics.

brands.name: First Street
brands.note: Physical climate risk data provider to be acquired; reported in Sustainability and Climate after closing
